title: Implement Request Logging with Error Handling
description: This feature adds logging for incoming requests and errors, providing valuable insights for debugging and performance optimization. It will handle logging of request metadata, response codes, and error messages, making it easier to identify and fix issues. This will improve the overall reliability and maintainability of the yantraverse framework
testCases: Test logging of edge cases like timeouts and invalid requests
acceptance: Request logging is enabled by default, and logs are written to the console or a file, with clear and readable formatting. Error handling is properly implemented to prevent crashes and provide meaningful error messages
reason: Implementing request logging with error handling will significantly improve the debuggability and reliability of the yantraverse framework, making it more attractive to developers and users who value robustness and performance
